_note: Seed content for MVP days 1-14. Sources are limited to widely-authenticated, non-sectarian Qur'an verses and hadith with clear citations. RECOMMENDATION FROM THE TEARDOWN MEMO STILL APPLIES: have a knowledgeable reviewer (imam/scholar) check this pool before shipping — this is a first draft, not a final source of truth.

ayah.text: They were not commanded except to worship Allah, sincere to Him in religion.

dua.arabic_translit: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatik
dua.translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, thank You, and worship You in the best manner.

days.reflection: What's one intention you want to renew today?
days.good_deed: Give a genuine thank-you to someone who helped you recently.

ayah.text: Whoever relies upon Allah — then He is sufficient for him.

dua.translation: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.

days.reflection: What's one worry you can hand over today instead of carrying alone?
days.good_deed: Reach out to someone who's going through a hard time.

ayah.text: If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favor].

dua.translation: All praise is for Allah, Lord of all the worlds.

days.reflection: Name three specific things you're grateful for today, even small ones.
days.good_deed: Send a short thank-you message to someone.

ayah.text: Seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.

dua.arabic_translit: Rabbana afrigh 'alayna sabran wa thabbit aqdamana
dua.translation: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet.

dhikr.phrase: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un
dhikr.note: said when facing difficulty, not a fixed-count dhikr

days.reflection: What's something hard right now that patience could soften?
days.good_deed: Be patient with someone who's testing your patience today — on purpose.

ayah.text: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.

days.reflection: Is there something you've been carrying guilt over that sincere repentance could release?
days.good_deed: Apologize to someone you may have wronged.

ayah.text: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease. Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.

dua.arabic_translit: Allahumma la sahla illa ma ja'altahu sahla, wa anta taj'alul hazna idha shi'ta sahla
dua.translation: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy, and You make the difficult easy if You wish.

dhikr.phrase: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah

days.reflection: What feels hard right now that you can trust will ease with time?
days.good_deed: Make something easier for someone else today — offer help before they ask.

ayah.text: And to parents, good treatment... 'My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small.'

dua.translation: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they raised me when I was small.

days.reflection: When did a parent or elder in your life sacrifice for you without asking for anything back?
days.good_deed: Call or message a parent/elder today, even briefly.

ayah.text: Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.

dua.arabic_translit: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal
dua.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and grief, from helplessness and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, from being overcome by debt and overpowered by others.

days.reflection: Name the anxious thought sitting with you right now, then read this dua slowly.
days.good_deed: Check in on someone you know is anxious or stressed.

ayah.text: Whoever hopes for the meeting with his Lord — let him do righteous work and not associate anyone in the worship of his Lord.

dua.arabic_translit: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika an ushrika bika wa ana a'lam
dua.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from associating anything with You knowingly.

days.reflection: Do one small good deed today and tell no one about it.
days.good_deed: (same as reflection — the act itself is the deed)

days.reflection: If today were your last day, what would you want to have already done?
days.good_deed: Do the good deed you've been postponing.

ayah.text: The example of those who spend their wealth in the way of Allah is like a seed which grows seven spikes; in each spike is a hundred grains.

days.reflection: What's one small act of charity you can give today — money, time, or a kind word?
days.good_deed: Give something today, however small, without expecting anything back.

hadith.text: The best of you are those with the best character.

days.reflection: Where did your character show up well this week? Where could it improve?
days.good_deed: Choose the kinder response the next time you're tested today.

ayah.text: And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?

days.reflection: What would change if you truly believed Allah's mercy is bigger than your mistakes?
days.good_deed: Extend the same mercy to someone else that you hope for yourself.

hadith.text: The most beloved deeds to Allah are those done consistently, even if small.

days.reflection: Looking back at these 14 days — what's one small habit you want to keep going?
days.good_deed: Pick your one habit and commit to it for another 7 days.
